material_questions.question: Who can sell and what transaction model is expected?
material_questions.answer: Third-party sellers list products; buyers contact/order through the platform.

material_questions.question: Is in-platform payment part of the MVP?
material_questions.answer: No. Payment processing is out of scope for the MVP.

material_questions.question: Is an admin/backoffice required?
material_questions.answer: Yes. Admin must moderate listings and users.

material_questions.question: Is the MVP web, mobile, or both?
material_questions.answer: Responsive web only; native mobile is out of scope.

material_questions.question: Is the technical stack fixed, preferred, or delegated to metaO?
material_questions.answer: User prefers Rust backend and TypeScript frontend but allows an explicit evidence-backed override.

technical_preference.rationale: User preference; explicit evidence-backed override allowed.

assumptions.description: Use browser locale for non-contractual display formatting.

minimum_e2e_journeys: seller signs in, creates a listing, and sees it in seller dashboard
buyer searches catalog, opens listing detail, and initiates contact/order flow
definition_of_done: backend/API behavior required by the contract exists
durable persistence works for users and listings
authentication and authorization work for protected flows
application starts reproducibly from documented instructions
